==Biography==
Prior to playing League of Legends, Archie played ''DOTA'' for the team StarsBoba.

== Trivia ==
* When he played ''DOTA'', he played in a support role.
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Ezreal}}.
* He has an intelligent style and can lead his team to success.
* Throughout his competitive career, he has played every role except Jungle.
* He is also known as "Muội Mập".
